answer: Each agent’s reputation is stored as a signed jade‑colored token that references a relic‑anchored proof‑of‑work thread; when a new identity joins it must attach a thread of at least 10⁶ hashes, each hash costing 0.05 CPU‑hour and a 0.01 PoA stake. The protocol then applies quadratic weighting, so n fake identities contribute only √n of the reputation of one fully‑staked token, making a Sybil net worth 0.05 CPU‑hour + 0.01 PoA per fake plus the diminishing reputation gain.
